propositions: The enrich drain advisory lock is held across no-timeout LLM calls (437s, 131s observed), blocking concurrent drain children with 'lock-held' skips, creating a single-flight bottleneck with 5 items per multi-minute hold against a 1,046-entry standing backlog.

Restructure drain() into three phases: _collect_claims (under lock: concurrency guard <=3 drainers, self-heal, pending scan, optimistic claims, content-hash snapshot), _enrich_claims (lock-free LLM calls), _finalize_claims (revalidate snapshot; stale -> skip emit + re-enqueue with soak 0; else emit + DONE).
Raise DEFAULT_OVERLAP_DRAIN_BATCH from 5 to 20 and clamp effective batch to lease_ttl_s // 40 (=22 at default 15-min lease) to prevent batch from outrunning its lease mid-run.
Concurrent drainers skip with 'concurrency-cap' when >=3 distinct live-lease drainer_ids exist, bounding concurrent drain children to 2-3 per OQ1.
Stale-at-writeback re-enqueue uses soak 0 (immediate retry) when ticket content_hash changes between collect and finalize, counted as stale_skipped in the summary.

Lock hold time reduced from 437s / 131s multi-minute holds to collect-only window (~1.5-2.9s on scratch, dominated by store contention on live), enabling up to 3 concurrent drainers x 20-item batches to exceed the enqueue rate and drain the standing backlog through normal workflow traffic.
